notes.title: Steam Trading Cards are Now Available!
notes.notes: Steam trading cards are now available for RePete! Collect rewards while you create time paradoxes! Collect three and trade for the other two to get badges, backgrounds, and more.

notes.title: RePete in Spanish
notes.notes:
¡Hola!

Thanks to Steam user Joseahfer, RePete is now available in Spanish! If you haven't played RePete yet, now's a great time to try it in your own language. Or, if Spanish isn't your language, play it in Spanish anyways for a whole different kind of experience.

Luke
